"""
Project Title: Dynamic Graph CNN for 3D Point Cloud Classification (ai-ml-ds-DGCNNPC2025)
File Name: dynamic_graph_cnn_pointcloud_classification.py

Short Description:
Implements DGCNN in Keras for shape classification on ModelNet40.
Builds dynamic graphs via KNN in TensorFlow, EdgeConv layers, and global aggregation.
Trains and evaluates on TensorFlow Datasets' ModelNet40.
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds  # type: ignore

# ----------------------------
# 1. Hyperparameters & Setup
# ----------------------------
SEED: int = 42
tf.random.set_seed(SEED); np.random.seed(SEED)
NUM_POINTS: int = 1024       # type: int = points per cloud
K: int = 20                  # type: int = nearest neighbors
BATCH_SIZE: int = 32         # type: int = batch size
EPOCHS: int = 100            # type: int = training epochs
LR: float = 1e-3             # type: float = learning rate
NUM_CLASSES: int = 40        # type: int = ModelNet40 classes
LOG_DIR: str = "./dgcnn_logs"
os.makedirs(LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# ----------------------------
# 2. KNN Graph Utilities
# ----------------------------
@tf.function
def knn(x: tf.Tensor, k: int) -> tf.Tensor:
    # x: (B,N,D), return idx: (B,N,k)
    B,N,D = tf.unstack(tf.shape(x))
    # compute pairwise distance
    x_expand = tf.expand_dims(x, 2)  # (B,N,1,D)
    diff = x_expand - tf.expand_dims(x, 1)  # (B,N,N,D)
    dist = tf.reduce_sum(diff*diff, -1)  # (B,N,N)
    _, idx = tf.nn.top_k(-dist, k=k)  # nearest k
    return idx  # (B,N,k)

@tf.function
def get_edge_features(x: tf.Tensor, idx: tf.Tensor) -> tf.Tensor:
    # x: (B,N,D), idx: (B,N,k)
    B,N,D = tf.unstack(tf.shape(x))
    k = tf.shape(idx)[-1]
    idx_flat = tf.reshape(idx, (B,-1))
    batch_indices = tf.reshape(tf.repeat(tf.range(B)[:,None], N*k, axis=1),(-1,))
    gather = tf.gather_nd(x, tf.stack([batch_indices, tf.reshape(idx_flat,(-1,))],1))
    neigh = tf.reshape(gather, (B,N,k,D))
    x_tile = tf.expand_dims(x,2)  # (B,N,1,D)
    x_tile = tf.repeat(x_tile, k, axis=2)
    edge = tf.concat([x_tile, neigh - x_tile], axis=-1)  # (B,N,k,2D)
    return edge  # (B,N,k,2D)

# ----------------------------
# 3. EdgeConv Layer
# ----------------------------
class EdgeConv(layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self, out_channels: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.mlp = tf.keras.Sequential([
            layers.Conv2D(out_channels, (1,1), activation="relu", use_bias=False),
            layers.BatchNormalization()
        ])
    def call(self, x: tf.Tensor) -> tf.Tensor:
        # x: point features (B,N,D)
        idx = knn(x, K)  # (B,N,K)
        edge = get_edge_features(x, idx)  # (B,N,K,2D)
        edge = self.mlp(edge)  # (B,N,K,C)
        out = tf.reduce_max(edge, axis=2)  # (B,N,C)
        return out

# ----------------------------
# 4. Build DGCNN Model
# ----------------------------
inp = Input((NUM_POINTS,3), name="points")
x = inp
# initial MLP
x = layers.Conv1D(64,1,activation="relu")(x)
x = layers.BatchNormalization()(x)
# EdgeConv blocks
x1 = EdgeConv(64)(x)
x2 = EdgeConv(64)(x1)
x3 = EdgeConv(128)(x2)
x4 = EdgeConv(256)(x3)
# Concatenate
x_cat = tf.concat([x1,x2,x3,x4], axis=-1)  # (B,N,512)
# Global feature
x_global = layers.GlobalMaxPooling1D()(x_cat)  # (B,512)
# Classifier
x_fc = layers.Dense(512, activation="relu")(x_global)
x_fc = layers.Dropout(0.5)(x_fc)
x_fc = layers.Dense(256, activation="relu")(x_fc)
x_fc = layers.Dropout(0.5)(x_fc)
out = layers.Dense(NUM_CLASSES, activation="softmax")(x_fc)
model = Model(inp, out, name="DGCNN_PointCloud")
model.compile(optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR),
              loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy", metrics=["accuracy"])
print(model.summary())

# ----------------------------
# 5. Data Pipeline
# ----------------------------
def preprocess(example):
    pc = tf.cast(example["points"],tf.float32)
    # random uniform sampling
    idx = tf.random.shuffle(tf.range(tf.shape(pc)[0]))[:NUM_POINTS]
    pc = tf.gather(pc, idx)
    label = tf.cast(example["label"],tf.int32)
    return pc, label

ds_train = tfds.load("modelnet40", split="train", as_supervised=False)
ds_train = ds_train.map(preprocess).shuffle(1000).batch(BATCH_SIZE).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)
ds_test  = tfds.load("modelnet40", split="test",  as_supervised=False)
ds_test  = ds_test.map(preprocess).batch(BATCH_SIZE).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)

# ----------------------------
# 6. Training
# ----------------------------
model.fit(ds_train, epochs=EPOCHS, validation_data=ds_test, verbose=2)
model.save(os.path.join(LOG_DIR,"dgcnn_model.h5"))

# ----------------------------
# 7. Example Use Cases
# ----------------------------
# Use case 1: classify a single cloud
for pc,label in ds_test.take(1):
    pred = model.predict(pc)
    print("True:", label[0].numpy(), "Pred:", np.argmax(pred[0]))
# Use case 2: batch inference
pcs, labels = next(iter(ds_test))
preds = model.predict(pcs)
print("Batch accuracy (first batch):", np.mean(np.argmax(preds,1)==labels.numpy()))

This DGCNN project leverages dynamic graph construction and EdgeConv layers in Keras to classify 3D shapes—far beyond basic CNN or RNN tasks. Perfect for advanced research in point‑cloud deep learning and graph neural networks.🚀🔥😊
